en: Fixed a failed `agent()`, `parallel()` or `pipeline()` call that a workflow script awaits later, or not at all, being treated as an unhandled promise rejection, which could end a background session
zh: 修复失败的 `agent()`、`parallel()` 或 `pipeline()` 调用（workflow 脚本稍后等待或完全不等待）被当作未处理的 promise 拒绝，从而可能结束后台 session 的问题
